_key_note: Ticket ids are KEY-001, KEY-002 ... issued in order, never reused.
_repos_note: The sources this knowledge base covers. kind: code | reference, or wiki and team for this repo. base: the branch drift measures against. A reference repo may carry pin (the commit read) and upstream. A code repo may carry roles: a path pattern to a role, such as "src/net/**": "protocol", proposed when the repo is added; the longest pattern wins, and a file no rule names gets a built-in role (service, controller, repository ...).
_controls_note: A few known questions per source, each with the file it must return near the top: { "question": "how are worlds saved", "expect": "src/world/Save.java", "source": "Game" }. No source means this repo. Proposed when a source is added, run after every rebuild, counted in the health line.
_search_note: search.weights: a path pattern to a tier (binding, current, reference, record, superseded) or a number added to a hit's score; the longest pattern wins.
